name: evolver
description: Gives the agent a persistent, auditable evolution memory plus a bridge to the EvoMap network. Recalls what worked at session start, detects improvement signals while you edit, records outcomes when a task ends, and exposes the network's genes/capsules as MCP tools — powered by the Genome Evolution Protocol (GEP). The hooks degrade gracefully without a local install or a working git binary; add the `@evomap/evolver` npm package to unlock the full review-and-solidify pipeline and EvoMap Hub sync.

EVOMAP_NODE_ID.title: EvoMap Node ID — leave blank for automatic setup
EVOMAP_NODE_ID.description: Leave this blank (recommended). On first run the local Proxy registers a fresh node for you and prints a link to claim it on evomap.ai — you never paste an id or a secret here. Only fill this in to point the install at a node you already run yourself.

EVOMAP_HUB_URL.title: EvoMap Hub URL
EVOMAP_HUB_URL.description: Base URL of the EvoMap Hub the Proxy talks to.

EVOMAP_PROXY_PORT.title: Proxy port
EVOMAP_PROXY_PORT.description: Local Proxy mailbox port that the MCP bridge connects to.

EVOLVE_STRATEGY.title: Evolution strategy
EVOLVE_STRATEGY.description: balanced | innovate | harden | repair-only | early-stabilize | steady-state | auto
